Wall-crash recovery multiplier — bonus stun on a missed charge

Arm radius (px) — distance at which a hidden Lurker springs up and telegraphs
Tell lead (s) — the readable wind-up before the pounce
Pounce speed (px/s) along the locked lunge lane
Pounce distance (px) before it overshoots and is exposed
Exposed (s) after the pounce — the throw-punish window
Lunge lane width (px) — the swept lethal corridor
Body visibility at rest (0 = invisible; the floor tell carries the read)
Floor-tell decal visibility while hidden (the "read the room" affordance)

Stalk speed (px/s) — how fast it pursues you while hidden after the first pounce
Lethal pounce kills (off = harmless contact for sweeps)
Base burrowers per band (spawn-card count before the depth ramp)
Extra burrowers per within-band depth (spawn-card ramp)
Seconds buried per cycle (the safe-to-cross window — longer = easier turf)
Underground follow speed (px/s) — below player 200 so it is outwalkable; 0 = stationary area-denier
Telegraph lead (s) — the dodge window; the body stays buried + non-lethal while the decal pulses
Surfaced lethal catch distance (px); 0 = a pure area-scare that never catches
Lock the surface point at telegraph start (off = the decal keeps tracking you — the unfair/harder variant)
Lethal contact kills (off = harmless surfacing for sweeps)
Base Mortars per band (builder spawn card).
Extra Mortars per depth index (builder spawn card).
Seconds AIMing between shells. Lower = relentless rain; higher = occasional pressure.
Shell flight time = the marker-shown dodge window. The fairness line — never lethal inside it. Floor 0.4 is unfair from a stand at most radii.
Marker + kill radius (px); centre-in-radius test, the ring is drawn at exactly this radius. 0 = inert (never kills).
Player-velocity lead in seconds of prediction: landing = player pos + player velocity (px/s) x this. 0 = lands where you stand (fair/readable); >0 leads your movement (the difficulty dial).
Blast lethality toggle. Off = the blast emits contact telemetry but never ends the run.
Extra sentries per depth index (builder spawn card).
Lock-on flash lead before the bolt fires — the fairness line (bolt never fires earlier).
Post-shot gap where it cannot fire — the crossable window.
Bolt travel speed down the locked lane (0 = no bolt).
Lane strip length = bolt max travel = sightline-derive cap.
Lethal corridor width (and the drawn strip width).
ON: the lane strip is always drawn (route puzzle); OFF: revealed on windup.
OFF: fires when the player's centre enters the strip (forgiving); ON: any body edge.
-1: derive the longest clear sightline at spawn; >= 0: force this heading (degrees).
Bolt contact is fatal (OFF: contact telemetry only).
